output.reason: [ev-5a31c0781dc5] and [ev-1295567312b0] say the `istiod-remote` Helm chart was merged into `istio-discovery`. Remote clusters are now installed with `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote`, and [ev-274ce3859ab9] says the chart was removed. So the exposed environments are those installed with the `istiod-remote` chart. The proposed exposure, values-key `global.profile` unset, is far too broad: it would flag nearly every ordinary `istiod` install that never used the remote chart. It also treats `global.profile` as the removed thing, when what was removed is a chart. The evidence names no values key, field, label or other config predicate that marks an `istiod-remote` chart release, so no correct condition follows and I cannot write a correction.
